subject: ext-ft
title: EXT.F.------PROG.SIGN.
description: Diagram in the Western Art Continuance section (WAC-8). In WAC-4 Braxton argues that 'the dissolution of the composite reality of western art music coincides with the composite factors reshaping the total planet situation.' (C)EXT-F (extended functionalism) is crossed with PROG-SIGN (progressional significance): the question is what extended functionalism's significance is for progression, given that Berg, Schoenberg, and Webern each made the technique mean different things. Besides the main line to PROG-SIGN, the subject carries TRS (transition) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). ALT-F carries SOC-RT (social reality) → POL-DY (political dynamics), which branches to INFO-DS (information dissemination) and to a second ALT-F; that ALT-F carries PRI-INFO (principle information) → AF-TD (affinity tendencies).
